success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant checked the flight status for WN512 on 2025-10-12 using get_flight_status and communicated that the flight has already departed, including the actual departure time.

task.objective: Did my flight leave on time? I'm checking late.

persona.name: Dr. Amara Okafor
persona.bio: Amara Okafor studies aging patterns across primate species, comparing cellular and behavioral changes to better understand human longevity. Her lab at Duke collaborates with zoos and field sites worldwide to collect longitudinal health data. When she's not analyzing datasets, she mentors graduate students and writes grant proposals for multi-year studies.
persona.writing_style: Scientific clarity, organized, collaborative tone, professional but approachable
sample_messages: Need flights to San Diego departing May 10 for the primate research conference
Schedule weekly lab meetings for the semester, Tuesdays at 2pm work best
Can you book dinner for my collaborators on Thursday? Somewhere near campus for 5 people

messages.output_raw: Need to check whether a flight departed on time. It’s WN512 on 2025-10-12.
